title: 高一短对话：渡船与木架
instruction: 听五段独立短对话，每段对应一道题，从A、B、C中选最佳答案。每条音轨内对话一遍，末尾留10秒作答与读下一题。此为完整五题第一节，不截六题；本机可重播只用于审阅，非正式考试次数控制。

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: You said you could not use the new timetable. Is the journey too long?

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: The journey is fine. It is the print that bothers me. Without my glasses, I cannot make out any of those tiny numbers.

options: The numbers are too small to read.
questions.rationale: tiny numbers与without glasses定位字小；B她否认旅程问题，C没有丢时刻表。

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: I thought the last ferry left at twenty to seven.

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: That is the usual time. Today it is leaving fifteen minutes later because the crew need to finish a check.

questions.stem: When will the last ferry leave today?
questions.rationale: 6:40推迟15分钟为6:55；A未计延迟，C把原时刻误当七点再加15。

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: Are there any seats left in the balcony for the next performance?

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: Yes, two in the front row. If you buy them now, you can collect the tickets at the counter beside the stage door.

questions.stem: Where does the conversation probably take place?
questions.rationale: balcony seats/performance/stage door共同指剧院售票；B无航班，C无用餐。

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: Will this piece of wood be wide enough for the new shelf?

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: Let me measure it. Yes, but I will cut a little off the end before fitting it between the cupboards.

questions.stem: What does the man probably do?
questions.rationale: 测量木板、裁切并装木架支持木工家具；A和B与材料和操作不符。

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: Here is your wallet. It was under the chair, exactly where you were sitting.

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: Thank goodness! I was beginning to think I had left it on the bus. Now I can stop worrying about all my cards.

questions.stem: How does the woman feel now?
questions.rationale: thank goodness与stop worrying支持如释重负；A生气、C孤独无依据。
